sources.title: Independent episode-value, terminal-clock, resampling and selection witnesses
sources.author: Causal banking proposal project
supported_claims: Two-period finite law gives target5 with sample TIS3 and PDIS15/4.
Terminal convention gives value2 versus10 and stipulated net-4 versus4.
Fixed normalized scores and recomputed bootstrap ratios have variances9/2 and9/4 in the stated finite example.
All-zero Bernoulli sample has probability(99/100)^20; conditional symmetric Student pivot coverage is1-2alpha.
Twenty independent nominal5% false admissions yield1-0.95^20; lower-tail name/value pairing has an exact adversarial witness.
